items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: what's that Nixon, the violin player? Andrew Nixon. He was the one, he was the only man in that band could read

ctx.x: And after Bunk left off the Spirit Band, and went with Eagle Band, nobody didn't worry about him, because everybody knows what kind of band that Eagle Band was, it wasn't nothing. They'd play, see, because what's that Nixon, the violin player? Andrew Nixon. He was the one, he was the only man in that band could read, and he'd learn them how to play a chorus or a number, that's what they'd play.
The rest of them were starting to, as well as they say, a ratty bunch.
